$comment: Machine-readable risk-adaptive evidence profiles, non-compensatory gate model, and validator->claim mapping for the Code Change Intelligence evidence layer. Documentation-only. Companion to CHANGE_INTELLIGENCE_EVIDENCE_LAYER.md. Change Intelligence validators are PRODUCT evidence producers, not governance authorities; outputs flow through AssertionGovernanceRequest.evidence_refs into TAP and the existing authority chain. No new ProviderKind and no frozen-contract change.
positioning: UGC governs (forces + admits + authorizes) detection; it does not itself detect. Detection = independent evidence producers.

non_compensatory_gates.principle: Do not average evidence into one score. TAP emits per-claim coverage (AssertionCoverage), not a blended number; mandatory gates live in policy + Workflow Service + Decision Authority + ActionGate.
non_compensatory_gates.caveat: AssertionGovernanceResult.evidence_coverage is a per-claim float (contracts/assertion.py:44) and MUST NOT be used as a compensatory quality score.

gates.condition: evidence bound to old head SHA

detection_methods.catches: test suites that merely confirm the implementation (AI self-confirming tests)
detection_methods.claim: mutation score >= threshold on touched code
no breaking delta or approved exception

detection_methods.oracle: different model or human refuting the patch

bloat_dimensions.evidence: new direct/transitive packages; package size; SBOM diff
added code no production path invokes (ADVISORY — undecidable in general)
new forbidden dependency edges / layer violations (feeds StoryGraph)
coverage AND mutation sensitivity (not coverage alone)

bloat_measurement_rule: measure the change DELTA, not an arbitrary total-code threshold; compare against per-repository budgets in policy
ai_change_policy_pack: generating agent cannot be the final validating authority
same-agent tests are not sufficient evidence alone
an independent validator must challenge the implementation
added dependencies require explicit purpose + alternatives analysis
large generated patches require decomposition or elevated review
repair patches are new candidates, fully revalidated
changes to tests/CI/policies/validators get higher scrutiny
sensitive code cannot merge solely through AI approvals
exact approved head/base/merge artifact stays bound through execution

subsystem_components.maturity: MISSING (net-new; mostly thin adapters over external tools)

enabling_prerequisites.gap: no ClaimManifest type exists (nearest: TAP E5 EvidencePacket)

enabling_prerequisites.item: validator identity + version binding on evidence
enabling_prerequisites.gap: audit R18 — evidence types lack validator-id/version field
gate logic must not collapse into TAP coverage float

mvp_priority: mutation adequacy for sensitive modules only
SHA-bound signed evidence manifest with validator identity/version
fail-closed treatment of missing mandatory evidence
verdict: Architecturally sound and consistent with the readiness audit. Add Change Intelligence as an upstream product evidence layer feeding evidence_refs -> TAP; make outputs risk-dependent, mandatory, and non-compensatory. No new ProviderKind; no frozen-contract change. Does not alter the overall verdict: CODE GOVERNANCE READY WITH PREREQUISITES.
